verdict.rationale: Scoped, least-privilege credentials are a fair question for LangGraph, since it ships a deployable Agent Server that exposes API endpoints. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API keys, credential scoping, permissions, or authorization controls. The CLI and Agent Server items only describe running endpoints for runs, threads and assistants, not issuing restricted credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
